actions.reason: Cache the rendered vocabulary used by Tokenizer.save and reuse it when the vocabulary items are unchanged. This avoids repeating the expensive token rendering work across repeated saves of the same tokenizer while preserving the existing output and refreshing the cache if the vocabulary content or order changes.

         # write the vocab: for the human to look at
         vocab_file = file_prefix + ".vocab"
         inverted_merges = {idx: pair for pair, idx in self.merges.items()}
-        rendered_vocab = {idx: render_token(token) for idx, token in self.vocab.items()}
+        vocab_items = tuple(self.vocab.items())

+        else:

+            self._rendered_vocab_cache = (vocab_items, rendered_vocab)
